verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a HubSpot CLI (@hubspot/cli), REST endpoints, per-endpoint OpenAPI specs and MCP servers, but nothing names an official client SDK or language library to build against. A CLI, raw REST endpoints and OpenAPI specs are adjacent tools or developer building blocks, not SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
